jobs.title: Full-Time Security Guard – Patrol & Surveillance
jobs.description:
Security Solutions of Texas in the Greater Houston Area is hiring for a full-time Security Guard. The role protects client property from criminal activity and trespassing, requiring vigilance and reliable transportation.

Ideal candidates will have strong written and verbal communication, sharp observation skills, and surveillance experience. The position is a 1099 contractor with pay levels and room for experience.
